summary: Write g_l = a_l·diag(p on J_l, 1)·b_l with a_l, b_l ∈ K_l and apply `mem_raises_of_jet_bound` with the diagonal: the jet bound is `norm_jetSeries_le` combined with the divisibility of Schur jets `norm_schurJet_le` (charges: one per box of a height-one column moved by the diagonal), and the exponents are reorganized into ∑ A_l + liftLoss.

steps.claim: p ∤ g₀g₁N, p ≥ 1; choose i_l ≤ 𝔯 with g_l in the basic double coset of index i_l.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨N, p1 : 1 ≤ (p : ℝ)⟩ := hΛ.not_dvd_gProd_mul_N, mod_cast hp.1.pos; choose i hi hc using hc

steps.claim: Choose subsets J_l of the coordinates with #J_l = i_l.
steps.lean: choose! J _ hJ using fun l h ↦ exists_subset_card_eq (le_card_of_mem_basicDoubleCoset (hc ⟨l, h⟩))

steps.claim: g_l = a_l·diag(p on J_l, 1)·b_l with a_l, b_l ∈ K_l (basic double coset).
steps.lean:
choose a ha b hb e using fun l : Λ ↦ DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset.1
    ((basicDoubleCoset_eq (diagGL_mem_basicDoubleCoset (ϖ := .mk0 p NeZero.out)
    (by simp [← v_algebraMap_eq_valuation, ← hΛ.valuation_p l.2]) _).1).le (hJ _ l.2 ▸ hc l))

steps.claim: Rewrite atSplits(g) as the product of the three families.

Apply `mem_raises_of_jet_bound` (δ = 1; translateDatum ∈ Std_1 by `translateDatum_mem_standardData`) with x = atSplits(a), y = atSplits(b) (in K_f) and the diagonal point, whose component at w is diag(p^{[w∈Λ, i∈J_w] − [(w̄, i) ∈ Λ.σJ]}); remaining: that description and the jet bound.
steps.lean:
refine Parameters.mem_raises_of_jet_bound (δ := 1) (H.translateDatum_mem_standardData hQ N.2.1 h j
    (.inr N.1)) (Kf_le_localLevel ?_) (Kf_le_localLevel ?_) (fun _ ↦ (?_ : ∀ w (f : _ →+* ℂ_[p]),
    (atPlace w _).1.map f = .diagonal fun i ↦ p ^ (ite (w ∈ Λ ∧ i ∈ J w) 1 0 - ite (⟨star w,
    i⟩ ∈ Λ.sigma J) 1 0 : ℤ)) _ _) ?_ <;> first | rwa [atSplits_mem_Kf] | clear * - hΛ p1 hJ hi

steps.claim: The description at each place w (cases w ∈ Λ, w̄ ∈ Λ).
steps.lean:
intro w; by_cases w ∈ Λ <;> by_cases star w ∈ Λ <;> simp_all [apply_ite, hΛ.1,
    ← map_inv, atPlace_star (star_star w), atPlace_atSplits _ _ ⟨_, _⟩,
    mem_supportedOn.1 (atSplits_mem_supportedOn _ _)]

steps.claim: For f ∈ Std_1: the normal form of theta products at p (`thetaProducts_normal_form`, χ_K(p) ≠ 1).
steps.lean: intro _ hf _ _; obtain ⟨_, _, u, v, H⟩ := P.thetaProducts_normal_form _ hΛ.4.2

steps.claim: The jet bound of `mem_raises_of_jet_bound` for f ∈ Std_1 and indices i′, i.
steps.lean:
grw [show ‖ιₚ (schurJet _ _ _ _)‖ ≤ p ^ (_ - D.jetExponent p j _) from norm_jetSeries_le hf _
    (.proj _ ∘ₗ .proj _ ∘ₗ schurJet _) (r := p ^ (_ : ℝ)) fun Θ h ↦ by
    erw [map_schurJet (isLiftWeight_kappa ..)]; simp_rw [jetExponent,
      ← card_X]; exact norm_schurJet_le (ev := evenPlaces Λ) (isLiftWeight_kappa ..).1 u v
      ((fun w h b ↦ ite (w ∈ Λ ∧ h = 1 ∧ b ∉ J w ∨ ⟨star w, b⟩ ∈ Λ.sigma J) 1 0) ∘ inducedPlace) (by
      grind [IsMarked, IsServed, chiK_cases, inducedPlace_neg_pow_mul_of_odd, star_star]) ((H _ (by
      simpa [P.norm_iota_periodFactor_eq_one _ (hΛ.4.2 ∘ P.chiK_eq_one_of_dvd Fact.out)] using
        norm_star_piG_le_one) _ h).1 _), ← zero_add (Λ.sum _),
    hΛ.sum_inducedPlace_sub_star_eq_zero (j + 1) fun c w ↦ #(J w) * ((D.n j / 2 : ℤ) - c)]

steps.claim: Bound the Schur jet entry (next fact).

|ιₚ(schurJet entry of T f)| ≤ p^{(charges) − jetExponent(p, j, evenPlaces Λ)}: by `norm_jetSeries_le` with the entry as linear form; for a theta product, `norm_schurJet_le` with ev = evenPlaces(Λ) and charge 1 on the boxes moved by the diagonal (exempted couplings checked from IsMarked/IsServed and the partner places), and null-cone integrality from the normal form (|ιₚ(c s₁)| ≤ 1).
steps.lean:
show ‖ιₚ (schurJet _ _ _ _)‖ ≤ p ^ (_ - D.jetExponent p j _) from norm_jetSeries_le hf _
    (.proj _ ∘ₗ .proj _ ∘ₗ schurJet _) (r := p ^ (_ : ℝ)) fun Θ h ↦ by
    erw [map_schurJet (isLiftWeight_kappa ..)]; simp_rw [jetExponent,
      ← card_X]; exact norm_schurJet_le (ev := evenPlaces Λ) (isLiftWeight_kappa ..).1 u v
      ((fun w h b ↦ ite (w ∈ Λ ∧ h = 1 ∧ b ∉ J w ∨ ⟨star w, b⟩ ∈ Λ.sigma J) 1 0) ∘ inducedPlace) (by
      grind [IsMarked, IsServed, chiK_cases, inducedPlace_neg_pow_mul_of_odd, star_star]) ((H _ (by
      simpa [P.norm_iota_periodFactor_eq_one _ (hΛ.4.2 ∘ P.chiK_eq_one_of_dvd Fact.out)] using
        norm_star_piG_le_one) _ h).1 _)

steps.claim: Add the vanishing sum of `sum_inducedPlace_sub_star_eq_zero` (stage j + 1, G(c, w) = #J_w·(⌊n_j/2⌋ − c)).
steps.lean:
, ← zero_add (Λ.sum _),
    hΛ.sum_inducedPlace_sub_star_eq_zero (j + 1) fun c w ↦ #(J w) * ((D.n j / 2 : ℤ) - c)]

steps.claim: Collect all exponents into one sum over τ (markExponent, liftLoss, lowColumns, lastEntry).
steps.lean:
simp (disch := positivity) only [norm_zpow, norm_p_eq_inv, inv_zpow', ← rpow_sum_of_pos, add_sub,
    markExponent, ← rpow_intCast, lastEntry, sum_filter, ← rpow_mul, placeOfEmb_comp_star,
    ← rpow_add, push_cast, ← inducedPlace.eq_1, liftLoss, lowColumns, mul_sum, card_filter,
    ← sum_ite_mem_eq D.tops, ← sum_add_distrib, Λ.sum_comm]

steps.claim: Cases on whether inducedPlace τ or its conjugate is in Λ.
steps.lean:
by_cases inducedPlace τ ∈ Λ <;> by_cases star (inducedPlace τ) ∈ Λ <;> simp_all [hΛ.1,
    add_assoc]; norm_cast

steps.claim: The height-one column count equals ∑_{h<n_{j+1}} [h = 1]·κ(τ, h).
steps.lean: show ite .. = ∑ h ∈ range (D.n (j + 1)), ite (h = 1) (D.κ τ h) 0 by simp [κ, n]; grind]
steps.typed_fact: ite .. = ∑ h ∈ range (D.n (j + 1)), ite (h = 1) (D.κ τ h) 0

steps.claim: Split into the charged and uncharged boxes.
The charges of row i′ are at most the number of moved boxes: injectivity of the tableau columns (`tableau_col_injective`) and i_l ≤ 𝔯.
steps.lean:
exact (sum_le_sum fun _ _ ↦ card_le_card_of_injOn _ (mem_filter_univ · |>.1)
    (tableau_col_injective ..).injOn).trans (by simp [*]; grw [hi]; lia)
